title: Meet ‘Granny H’, the mystery knitter leaving toys for children
summary_full: A ninety-year-old woman named June Rose Hood secretly left knitted toys for village children. These mysterious gifts appeared for two years, sparking much speculation among residents. Hood, known as Granny H, found knitting therapeutic and a way to manage anxiety. Her grandson helped hide the handmade toys, which brought smiles to many faces. The community later celebrated Hood's kindness and her significant contribution to their village.
